name: Muse Spark 1.1
description: A multimodal reasoning model built for agentic tasks. It can autonomously use browsers, write and deploy code, and visually verify changes by taking and analyzing application screenshots.
keyFeatures: Multimodal debugging by correlating application screenshots directly with source code
Agentic browser control for automating web tasks (e.g., social media messaging)
curatorNotes: While internal Meta coding benchmarks claim top-tier performance, independent leaderboards suggest it currently performs closer to open-source models like GLM 5.2.
